recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Data Processing for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Adedapo & E. O. Babatunde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Data Processing Cycle and Stages of Computing
subtopics: Distinction between raw data, information, and wisdom
The data processing cycle: Data collection, data input, data processing, output, and storage
Stages in the historical evolution of data processing: Manual, mechanical, electro-mechanical, electronic
objectives: Define data processing and state 4 qualitative attributes of valuable information
Diagram the continuous 5-stage data processing cycle
Compare manual paper-based filing with electronic automated data processing

topics.topic: Data Collation, Preparation and Input Verification
subtopics: Methods of data collection: Questionnaires, interviews, biometric sensors, OCR, OMR forms
Data validation checks: Range check, format check, presence check, check digits
Data verification: Double-entry comparison and visual proofreading
objectives: Distinguish data verification from data validation in database systems
Explain how optical mark readers (OMR) score standardized WAEC examination answer sheets
Identify validation rules that prevent illegal date-of-birth entries

subtopics: File hierarchy: Characters -> Fields -> Records -> Files -> Database
File organization types: Serial, sequential, indexed-sequential, direct/random file organization
File access methods: Sequential search vs hashing direct access
objectives: Illustrate the file structure hierarchy of a Nigerian school pupil record
Compare sequential tape access with indexed-sequential database retrieval
Calculate storage space requirements for a relational table holding 100,000 voter records

topics.topic: Relational Database Concepts and Structured Query Language (SQL)
subtopics: Database Management Systems (DBMS) vs flat file systems
Relational concepts: Entities, attributes, tables, tuples, primary keys, foreign keys
Basic SQL Data Manipulation: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY clauses
objectives: Explain why relational databases prevent data redundancy and anomalies
Define primary and foreign keys in linking student tables to exam results
Write a basic SQL query to retrieve students scoring above 75% in Mathematics
